title: Sign-twisted function tester
statement: Let a nonadaptive tester query a domain $Omega$ at $r$ positions and receive sign-valued answers, and let $phase$ assign a sign to each domain point. The sign-twisted tester has the same seed space, seed distribution, and queries, and applies the original acceptance rule to the transcript whose present answers are multiplied by the phase at their queried points.
